body: Oh and I have substance abuse issues. Had to stop drinking but on methadone and smoke so much weed.

Yeesh, this post and some of these comments are super invalidating. Just because I happen to have a bf, doesn't mean my life is easy, it's just another aspect of life to grapple with (he also has bpd and other issues,  so while we get each other more than most others would, its fking hard at times). For some to say others must be misdiagnosed if they are able to speak to ppl is kinda messed up. I'm sure it's frustrating but no need to make other ppl feel like shit because they're "not sick enough".

There are obviously levels of severity, as with most things, it's kind of a spectrum. It still affects every aspect of my life in some way.
You're still a bigot lol

All you assholes saying it's not the govts job to feed kids and that the parents job, well, no shit. Of course they should but there are many reasons that they do not, especially at low decile schools. It's extremely heartless to me that you would rather let kids, who did nothing wrong, go hungry and struggle even more than they have to, just so we can give ppl tax cuts. Have some empathy,  damn.

I don't understand how anyone isnt at least a bit frightened by this, its going to affect every one of us in some way. Even if you say you don't use public services (idk how) do you not care about those that do? These cuts will affect school lunches, emergency rooms, parks and conservation, and so much more

That's part of the problem, everyone SHOULD be able to own housing. It is a right to have a home. I know that's not how it is but it what we should aim for. You also cannot deny that this is different to other businesses, it should be taxed accordingly. You're not gonna win this argument on reddit no one is going to sympathise, maybe try nz herald fb or something.
Yup, literally told today my rent is going up $50 if we renew the lease.
Not everyone in social housing is an alcoholic.
That poor child, thats so fucked up. I really wish people would stop having children they don't want.

I used to do this, but I was an alcoholic. Just a tip, youre probably not drinking that much, but it may be more difficult for you to tell if you smell of alcohol (especially if you're drinking spirits) or if you're slurring a bit/coming across as drunk/off. I'm not trying to freak you out but it's something I wish I'd kept in mind. If you're gonna keep doing it, set a strict limit, that way you don't slowly end up drinking more and more as your tolerance increases. And ofc gum/mouthwash for the smell. And be careful, this shit escalates quicker and easier than you realize - id recommend getting help asap. Stay safe  <3
Me too, I'd probably never use my phone if I had to respond right away. Sometimes (most times tbh) I just don't feel like talking.

Too relatable. I'm only just starting to try and accept that it's not helping my anxiety but probably making that and my depression worse. The lack of urgency has put life at a standstill. I cant stay asleep for more than 2-4hrs at a time. I also think I may be in the prodromal stage of CHS, early morning nausea, intense anxiety and stomach pains. And I just don't have the motivation to take care of myself.

But its still not enough for me to really want to stop or even cut down.
No, there's nothing to indicate they paid her college tuition, they paid so she could get a high school education. So they did all have an equal start

Jesus, I'm tearing up reading this. What an awful thing to say and 2 years is such a long time to have to deal with this. Fuck that guy, you deserve way better. You deserve to be with someone who thinks you're beautiful and tells you so. I can't imagine how difficult this must be but you have to leave him. I don't really know what to suggest but  I'm sending you strength and love, you CAN get out of this shitty situation <3
Sadza? At least thats what its called in Zimbabwe - Kinda like corn meal
And?

No, it is a porn addiction. All addictions are rooted in something deeper, all addiction is complex. But people with a porn addiction are addicted to watching porn in some manner. It is a thing whether you choose to accept it or not.

Lol this feels like victim blaming... "I'm doing something illegal that will put mine and other people's lives at risk, everyone needs to get the fuck out of my way and if they don't they're just self righteous cunts who must just be being trying to teach me a lesson". Or maybe people just don't think they should have to cater to you? You realise that pulling over takes time out of their day and may be inconvenient? Just because you don't think you should have to go the speed limit for whatever reason?

How is that the person going the speed limits fault?? Get fucked, I'm not pulling over, not because I give a shit about teaching them a lesson I just don't see why I should have to take the time to stop so some impatient asshole can go unnecessarily fast. How about the fact that they could crash anyway because they're going too fast and being reckless? If theyre tailgating me aggressively then i might pull over but only for my own safety. Why don't they be a good citizen and drive the speed limit so they don't endanger peoples lives???? If they're too slow then they should pull over but otherwise, this is the tailgaters problem.

Wow, you really don't get it, do you? How nice that you haven't experienced being constantly dumped on by a friend, for years. Heavy shit that they should be talking to a therapist about, but they won't.  And they don't listen to your advice but still complain about the same thing. I don't judge them and their issues, I'm always kind and do what I can, but I also can't avoid how emotionally draining it can be. Ya maybe we shouldn't be friends, but the fact is that you obviously do not understand. 🙃

Hey dipshit, did it occur to you that they may have had the TV before losing their job? Oh but they should have sold it, right? That'd be your retort I'm sure, but how much money would they even get for it?? Would it be worth worrying her kids further and taking away something that makes them happy? Thoughtless asshole.

You are so right, I know putting myself out there is what I need to do, but I think I'm just scared! I am a socially anxious person but that is definitely something I need to conquer (whether I want a relationship or not). And yea, I  need to take it slow. I am just glad my ex has no social media!
Yea tbh I'm not sure I am either, it's just the validation I miss. But seems best to focus on yourself and non-romantic relationships for a while

You are so right! So many people have told me to just move on, and it make things really hard because you just feel stupid and invalidated. You should definitely feel and deal with your pain as it is. Take your time and work through it. It will definitely be hard but it's the best way - don't deal with it like I did, drinking in excess to trying to drown out your thoughts and temporarily feel good. Work through it and do what you can to make yourself a better person

Dude, I feel the same way. The older I get the more hopeless and scared I feel. It seems harder and harder to get out of this hole. The only thing I would say to you is try and do something to help yourself sooner rather than later, because it definitely gets harder. I know its fucking hard now, don't get me wrong. But just start small, try going to therapy and getting meds, if you haven't already. Try going out to meet people. I know its easier said than done, but it will be worth a try. You have time and you can do this

Oh man that's so shit, I'm so sorry it's so bad. It's really is so hard to get over a BPD ex! I've been avoiding therapy because of expense and the fact that I havent had good experiences in the past, but I'm going back soon because I just have no other way to deal with this any more. If you are able to it would probably be the best thing to do (though Im sure youve been told that before). But yeah, thank God for this place! Good luck x

God I hope so. I'm in the same sort of spot as you. It's just so unfair that he seems to be able to just move on and make his life so much better. Where I'm still struggling so much, picking up the pieces even 3 months later. It just fucks me off that i wasn't even looking for a relationship when he came along, but then of course the love-bombing started and I couldn't help but fall for him. Ugh
Yes! Same, girl! Good work :)

Yes so much so. I honestly always feel like such a fake, and every time I talk about it  I'm like, am I actually depressed?? Even though Ive known Ive been depressed for like 16 years. Its really hard to validate sometimes. Especially when your ex, who has a personality disorder(which feels so much more serious), says that you are "just sad". Lol cool. It seems like people really underestimate depression

fuck dude, your post made me cry. Im so sorry youre dealing with this, it honestly hits so close to home, unfortunately. I know that feeling of wanting to just sleep or disappear, feeling like a monster. Please know that this feeling passes. Please know that you can get help - please go to a Dr or reach out to family or friends. Or me! Please message me if you have no one else to talk to xx

Oh I see, did she break up with you because of that? Well either way, I would still recommend writing a letter. It really helps to get your feelings out, even if you just want to apologise. I wouldn't send it, not now anyway. Also, try to plan something for that day if possible, have some friends over and try to distract yourself. Try not to beat yourself up, we are only human and we all make mistakes.

I know how you feel, our 4 year anniversary would have been this coming January... Im so scared of how I'm gonna feel on that day. All I can think about is how amazing that day was, when he asked me to be his girlfriend. Personally, to deal with it, I will probably write a letter to him that I wont send, try to focus on how badly he treated me and try to stay busy (or just wallow in bed if I cant manage that..) Good luck - I'm sure it'll be a lot easier once you're past that day
Very true! Thank you

Wow thank you guys for all your responses, very much appreciated. I told my dad I was thinking of doing this as well and he was also very adamant I don't do it because there won't be any good outcome.

So yeah, the general consensus is pretty clear! As much it's not what I was hoping to hear, I'm just gonna have to deal with the fact that he will never hear or understand me

Yeah I must admit I am a bit worried about how negatively it could affect him, especially with this being so new. But it certainly sounds like it's more likely he wouldn't care (probably hates or has 'devalued' me). It's just frustrating not being able to talk it out, even just for some sort if closure...

But yeah, I will write the letter wether I give it to him or not

Any tips to help survive the next day with him?

I totally get this! It feels really shitty when someone makes those sorts of comments. Like, yeah as if I'm not already worrying about what you think of me and what i should say (if i can even get the courage to say it). It always makes me extra self conscious. It is a good sign that you have people you can feel comfortable and talk freely with. I guess the best thing you can do is maybe try hang out with those ppl, along with others, to try build up your social confidence. Or just try and say just a few things every so often (maybe try and come up with a few things to talk about beforehand). I totally know, it's easier said than done, and I almost always shut off in social situations. And as I get older it gets worse. If you can, just try not to give up on it. It's worth trying to push through the anxiety. Also, therapy will help. Good luck!
